content.title: NFL Draft 2026 - Draft Experience Hours of Operation
content.text: 2026 NFL Draft | Registration | NFL.comApril 23 – 25 | FREE ENTRYNFL Draft Experience presented by American ExpressThe ultimate FREE football event with entertainment for all ages! Experience photos with the Vince Lombardi Trophy and Super Bowl Rings, interactive games and NFL FLAG clinics, star player and legend autographs, live music entertainment and local cuisine.VIP Ticket PackagesFeaturing the best seats to watch the action unfold, hospitality with elevated tailgate fare, beer and wine, NFL player appearances, the chance for behind-the-scenes tours and more, your trip to the 2026 NFL Draft will be memorable for years to come.Pittsburgh, PA unlocks the perfect backdrop for fans to witness future NFL stars find their new teams and participate in the NFL's ultimate fan festival at Draft Experience. Featured highlights include:Future Stars Take the StageAll 7 rounds of the NFL Draft announced LIVE at the Draft TheaterNFL FLAG ClinicsSeveral NFL Play60 flag football clinics throughout Draft WeekPlayer & Legend AutographsMeet and green opportunities with current NFL players and legendsNFL Exhibits & Photo OpsVince Lombardi Trophy, Super Bowl Rings, and moreInteractive GamesRun the 40 yard dash, kick a field goal, and compete in catching drills.Live Music & EntertainmentEnjoy all-day entertainment and local performances.Shop NFL MerchandiseOfficially licensed apparel & merchandise for all 32 teamsLegendary Acrisure StadiumExperience the iconic football stadium at the heart of the DraftNFL DRAFT EXPERIENCE - HOURS OF OPERATION
